notes: Updates now install themselves. This is the last version you should ever need to download by hand.

changelog.headline: What's new in 1.0.14

sections.title: Updates that take care of themselves
items: New versions download quietly in the background and install the next time ELLA restarts, or right away if you tap Restart to update.
A typical update is now a few megabytes instead of a hundred, because only the files that actually changed are sent.
Downloads pick up where they left off if your connection drops, instead of starting over.
Every file is checked against a signed list before anything on your PC is touched, and if a new version fails to start, the previous one is put back automatically.
If a small update can't be applied for any reason, the full installer runs on its own instead. Either way, nothing to download manually.

sections.title: Also in this release
items: A Personality switch in Settings, and a voice engine that only loads when spoken replies are on, so starting up is lighter.
Calendar changes report honestly: when a date can't be understood she asks instead of guessing today, and group changes say exactly what was done.
Mercury joins the line-up of models she can think with.

changelog.data_safety: Your chats, memory, notes, portfolio and settings stay exactly as they are. Updates only replace the app's own program files. Nothing you have created is touched or deleted.
